title: Diagrama de Arquitectura de Sistema de Agente AI
prompt:
An academic paper-level engineering schematic diagram with the theme of AI Agent System Architecture. Black and white line art style, similar to patent illustrations. Horizontal composition, white background with black lines.
The image is strictly divided into three vertical layers:
Upper layer (Physical Layer): Neatly arranged hardware icons, including LiDAR, cameras, GPU servers, and robotic arms.
Middle layer (Core Logic): Complex flowchart showing the agent's "brain". Contains rectangles labeled "LLM", "Memory", "Planning", with arrows connecting them to show data flow.
Lower layer (Environment Layer): Abstract grid floor representing the simulation environment, and simple building outlines representing the real world.
Overall style: Minimalist, vector lines, no shadows, high contrast, textbook illustration style.
